result.topic_en: Bare algebraic calculations with bracket (determinant-like) symbols such as (ad), (bd), (cd) built from linear relations among quantities a, b, c, d with coefficients α, β, γ, δ, aimed at eliminating to obtain a quadratic relation between products like ac·bd and ad·bc.
